item.title: Reminders keep the time you asked for
item.summary: When you schedule a recurring reminder in a named timezone, Murph now preserves that local time through saving and later edits.
item.details: The confirmation comes from the saved schedule and scheduler's next deliverable occurrence. If timing cannot be verified, or an old one-time reminder can no longer fire, Murph says so and offers a bounded recovery instead of inventing a time.

tryIt.label: Schedule a local-time reminder
tryIt.prompt: Remind me every day at 9 PM Central to wind down.
